intervals.reason: She is sleeping away from home on holiday in Split, Croatia.

She takes flight LO 578 from SPU to WAW.
She lands at Warsaw Chopin Airport and travels back to her home on ul. Chmielna.
She is back at home unpacking and settling in after her holiday.
She receives her scheduled grocery delivery at home.
She spends the rest of the evening at home resting before work tomorrow.
